acceptance_tests.name: bridge behaviour holds
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: ok is true and all adversarial mutation tests pass

acceptance_tests.name: scan is fresh and candidate-free
acceptance_tests.pass_condition: exit 0; summary.certified_records is 0, summary.learner_visible_records is 0, and the reported candidate count matches the committed scan

adversarial.expectation: any diff that loosens typed-graph, loc-surface or authority checks fails the packet
a report claiming any nonzero candidate count without new typed-graph evidence fails the acceptance test

positive.expectation: a missing_typed_graph_evidence row is reported with its canonical loc, written surface and the four authority digests
the report states 0 candidate records among 2,000, matching real-data-scan.meta.json exactly

candidate_population.selection_rule: the 95 rows of the first 2,000 carried crosswalk rows that reached the typed-graph gate and abstained with missing_typed_graph_evidence, as counted in qamus/examples/largelexicon-fact-bridge/real-data-scan.meta.json; all other abstentions are out of scope

commands.purpose: read the current machine truth: 0 candidates, 2,000 abstentions, and the authority bindings
re-prove the bridge behaviour before changing any input
regenerate the full typed-claim output into the gitignored out/ tree for inspection

defeaters: a proposed change that weakens the typed-graph, loc-surface or authority-binding requirement
a gap row that treats a bridge abstention as certified or candidate evidence
a gap row whose canonical loc does not match the bridge record it cites
any claim that GAP-L3 is closed while the typed-graph evidence is still missing
definition_of_done: every missing_typed_graph_evidence occurrence in the bounded window has an exact required-edge description
no bridge guard was weakened and no abstention was reported as a candidate
the authority digests the gap was computed against are recorded so the wave can be invalidated mechanically
GAP-L3 is only declared closed when the bridge yields candidates from real accepted typed edges

conditions: a collision needs occurrence context that no committed artifact supplies
a candidate would require an iʿrāb-bearing judgement to route
the carried-table dependency hashes changed mid-wave
escalation_trigger.route: two-vote queue for iʿrāb-bearing routes; source-gap packet for missing context; rerun the wave from a fresh release if the dependency hashes moved

evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: If the evidence ladder does not reach the rung a route needs, record source_gap with the precise missing evidence. Prefer pending over wrong.
evidence_policy.statement: Every gap row cites the bridge record's contract_id, its canonical quran loc and written surface, and the authority digests it was computed against. A carried-table lookup is source-addressed candidate evidence about a written surface; it is never, by itself, evidence of lexeme identity, sense, or function.

expected_outputs.description: one row per missing_typed_graph_evidence occurrence with the exact typed edge that would be required
generator, counts, and the authority digests (carried tables, typed graph, canonical index, lexeme lattice) the gap was computed against

guards: the METHOD of this gap analysis transfers to later waves; the linguistic conclusion about any single occurrence never transfers to another occurrence or surface
the bridge currently yields ZERO candidates: no report may present an abstention as a candidate
the crosswalk entry_id is the page that displays the word: it is page context and may never become a lexeme, form or sense edge
a root-family relation is never a lexeme identity, and a candidate-status graph edge is never accepted support
a normalized-only surface match is a never_auto_resolve trigger and must stay blocked
the bridge projector is registered never_auto_resolve; certification remains solely with tools/certify_typed_fact.py on its own evidence bundle

non_deployment.statement: This packet produces candidate dispositions and review routes only. No bridge record may be materialized publicly, shown to a learner, or written to the live site; certification stays with the owner-gated certifier on its own evidence bundle.

out_of_scope: relaxing the typed-graph requirement, the loc-surface agreement check or any bridge guard so that more rows pass
certifying a lexeme, form, sense or root edge from a bridge candidate: the projector is registered never_auto_resolve and has no certification path
resolving a lexical_collision_requires_context record by picking a candidate
any live-surface mutation, entry-store write, or public materialization
scope.summary: The A3 bridge is executable and abstention-first, but identity requires an accepted canonical typed lexeme/form edge agreeing on occurrence loc, written surface and entry, and the public repository supplies only 2 eligible edges at 1 occurrence loc. The repaired real-data scan therefore records 0 candidate records among 2,000 carried crosswalk rows, with 95 rows reaching the typed-graph gate and abstaining as missing_typed_graph_evidence. This packet closes that evidence gap: it produces the missing canonical typed lexeme/form edges for a bounded occurrence set through the existing typed-edge builder, then re-runs the bridge. It does not relax the bridge's evidence requirement.

title: Close the A3 typed-graph evidence gap that leaves the bridge at zero candidates
